Agency Project Description: Replacement of two (2) 42”dia cone valves and two (2) 60” butterfly valves located on the north and south line within the valve chamber of the EDRC in Downsville.  The 2 cone valves require replacement to isolate the polyjet regulating Valves.  The butterfly valves require replacement due to lack of closure & leakage.  Also included will be replacement of the Polyjet Valve Actuators and the 20” Gate Valve on the Conservation Line.  The valve replacements require the EDRC to be isolated, shutdown and bypassed.
